historical_audit_basis.candidate_difference_rule: Every member is provenance only. Fresh candidate code, runner, runtime, dependency and command hashes may differ; P2 must never compare a candidate member hash with this object.
historical_audit_basis.superseded_fixed_alias_rule: The 20260816_145644 pair preserves the rejected Round-2 fixed aliases and the 20260816_162320 pair preserves the rejected Round-3 fixed aliases byte-for-byte. Neither current fixed output path is a member, so this amendment has no self-lock; all listed source/test/protocol/review bytes remain provenance only.

plan_tracker_semantic_rebinding.effective_only_when: this amendment and a candidate covering the complete production/runner/P2-verifier/runtime/attestation closure receive fresh independent acceptance
plan_tracker_semantic_rebinding.rule: At every named P05M interface in the hash-bound plan/tracker, any phrase naming or describing the legacy count-metric fixture receipt denotes the complete canonical temporac.p05m-gate-capture-bundle.v1. The nested temporac.p05m-gate-evidence.v2 and legacy six-key receipt remain mandatory subordinate evidence and neither can ever be supplied directly.

evaluator_executable_closure.authoritative_rule: The listed current digest and member hashes are historical provenance only. The accepted candidate index supplies the authoritative member records and recomputed whole-closure digest, which may differ.
evaluator_executable_closure.member_rule: For each member append uint64_be(path_ascii_byte_length), path_ascii, uint64_be(raw_file_byte_length), raw_file_bytes. Lengths are unsigned 64-bit big-endian; raw bytes are not decoded or normalized.
evaluator_executable_closure.whole_closure_rule: evaluator_code_sha256 is this complete 17-member closure digest, not a metrics/evaluator subset and not a concatenation of member digests

production_dependency_dag.candidate_rule: Fresh candidate review recomputes the complete local import edge array from candidate raw bytes, requires every target to be one of module_origins, records that exact array and digest in the candidate index, and rejects importlib, __import__ calls, exec/eval-created imports, path mutation before the origin audit, namespace packages, zipimport for pams, or any unlisted local origin.
production_dependency_dag.edge_order: ascending pair (importer UTF-8 bytes, imported UTF-8 bytes), with no duplicate pair
production_dependency_dag.package_execution_rule: Normal CPython import semantics are mandatory: importing any pams.temporac member first executes the exact candidate bytes for pams/__init__.py and then pams/temporac/__init__.py. No isolated-loader bypass is permitted.

evaluator_dependency_contract.direct_import_scope: The arrays constrain direct imports in the production closure. Transitive imports are permitted only when every loaded origin is inside an exact runtime-lock tree and appears in the process module-origin manifest.

role_origin_rules.controller: Only the exact runner member plus locked CPython built-in/frozen/stdlib origins may load; pams, NumPy and SciPy origins are forbidden.
role_origin_rules.p2-verifier: Only the exact runner member plus locked CPython built-in/frozen/stdlib origins may load; pams, NumPy and SciPy origins are forbidden. The PASS-writing entry point is in this runner member.
role_origin_rules.production: The exact runner member, all actually imported 17-member production origins, and locked CPython/NumPy/SciPy origins may load; no other origin is permitted.
role_origin_rules.reference: The exact runner member, separately hashed reference source compiled with the frozen synthetic filename, and locked CPython/NumPy origins may load; pams and SciPy origins are forbidden.

evaluator_dependency_contract.transitive_closure_rule: The runtime lock contains the complete CPython executable/stdlib tree, complete installed NumPy and SciPy distribution trees plus wheels and RECORD files, and recursive native-image closure. Each p2-verifier/controller/production/reference process writes its complete actual post-scoring or post-verification module-origin manifest, native-image manifest and sandbox witness through the frozen FD-3 attestation pipe before stdout.

runtime_lock_contract.canonical_hash_rule: runtime_lock_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete canonical runtime-lock JSON bytes with one terminal LF; the object contains no runtime_lock_sha256 field
runtime_lock_contract.gpu_rule: No GPU device node is mounted and CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES is the empty string.
runtime_lock_contract.module_origin_rule: Entries are sorted by module_name UTF-8 bytes and cover every non-null sys.modules entry in the actual process. The reviewed runner takes two consecutive snapshots after scoring or P2 verification and output-object construction but before attestation serialization; both arrays must be byte-identical, and no import is permitted afterward. source/bytecode/extension origins bind exact raw files in a locked tree. built-in/frozen entries use origin_token=$PYTHON_EXECUTABLE_IMAGE, origin_relative_path built-in:<name> or frozen:<name>, and bind the exact executable bytes/hash. Reference additionally includes one required compiled-source pseudo-entry named temporac_p05m_reference_v1 with origin_token=$REFERENCE_SOURCE, origin_relative_path=<temporac-p05m-reference-v1>, and the exact reference source length/hash even if its execution dictionary was not inserted into sys.modules.
runtime_lock_contract.module_origin_manifest_hash_rule: module_origin_manifest_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete canonical entry array plus one terminal LF; no entry or manifest contains that digest.
runtime_lock_contract.native_image_rule: The actual attested manifest includes the executable and every executable mapping in /proc/self/maps plus every recursively resolved ELF interpreter and DT_NEEDED library reachable from those mapped images, ordered by (path_token, relative_path) UTF-8 bytes. The reviewed runner takes two consecutive post-scoring/post-verification snapshots and requires byte identity before attestation; the set must be a subset of and byte-equal to the locked native-image closure, with no unlisted mapped image.
runtime_lock_contract.native_image_manifest_hash_rule: native_image_manifest_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete canonical actual entry array plus one terminal LF. The full array and this digest occur in the FD-3 process attestation; the parent process witness repeats only the digest and must derive it from those received bytes.
runtime_lock_contract.network_rule: A fresh network namespace has no non-loopback interface and all socket creation/connect/bind syscalls are denied by the frozen sandbox profile.
runtime_lock_contract.path_token_rule: executable_path_token is exactly $RUNTIME/bin/python3.12; stdlib_root_token is $RUNTIME/stdlib; installed_root_token is $RUNTIME/site-packages; wheel_path_token is $RUNTIME/wheels/<wheel_filename>; record_relative_path is the unique distribution RECORD path relative to installed_root_token.
runtime_lock_contract.sys_path_activation_rule: With -I -S active, controller verifies the interpreter bootstrap paths, then replaces sys.path with sys_path_tokens_exact before any candidate-local, NumPy or SciPy import. Worker role imports occur only afterward. Any earlier third-party/local import, extra path, missing path, reordered path or origin mismatch is STOP-METRIC.
runtime_lock_contract.tree_preimage: ASCII tag temporac.p05m.runtime-tree.v1 followed by NUL, then for each relative path sorted by raw NFC UTF-8 bytes append uint64_be(path_byte_length), path_bytes, uint32_be(mode), uint64_be(raw_file_byte_length), raw_file_bytes. mode is exactly the low 12 POSIX permission bits as a nonnegative integer. Paths use forward slashes, are relative, contain neither empty, dot nor dot-dot segments, and raw bytes are not normalized.
runtime_lock_contract.tree_type_rule: Only directories and listed regular files may exist below a locked tree root; symlinks, hard links, devices, sockets and FIFOs are forbidden. Directories contribute no preimage member and are materialized mode 0555; every regular member appears exactly once.
runtime_lock_contract.wheel_rule: NumPy and SciPy installed trees must validate byte-for-byte against their exact locked RECORD bytes and separately bound wheel bytes; missing wheel, RECORD, installed member or recursive native image is STOP-METRIC.

sandbox_profile_contract.canonical_hash_rule: sandbox_profile_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete canonical sandbox-profile JSON bytes with one terminal LF; the object contains no sandbox_profile_sha256 field

filesystem.attestation_storage: FORBIDDEN: no sidecar, temporary file, shared memory object or writable mount carries attestation bytes; the only evidence channel is the anonymous pipe defined by attestation_transport_contract
filesystem.candidate_mount: $CANDIDATE is the verified content-addressed snapshot, mounted read-only and noexec except for CPython reading the exact runner/source members
filesystem.proc_mount: A role-private read-only procfs exposes only self, direct child handles owned by the parent role, mountinfo, fd/fdinfo, maps, stat, status and net/dev records required by the frozen witness algorithm; all path values are tokenized before evidence emission
filesystem.runtime_mount: $RUNTIME is the exact runtime lock, mounted read-only
filesystem.work_isolation_rule: All four work mounts are newly created empty mounts with pairwise-distinct Linux mount IDs, st_dev/st_ino pairs and independent 32-byte mount nonces. No role namespace can resolve another role token. The parent retains a mount handle, verifies the same identity and the exact empty tree after child exit, and rejects any extra directory entry, file, link, device, socket or FIFO.

sandbox_profile_contract.syscall_policy_rule: syscall_policy_base64 is the unique RFC 4648 standard-alphabet encoding with required padding and no whitespace; decoding must yield exactly syscall_policy_bytes and its SHA-256 must equal syscall_policy_sha256. The policy permits pipe2/read/write/close, pidfd/exit observation, read-only procfs witness reads and exact process creation, denies fsync on the attestation pipe, all filesystem creation/mutation and all unlisted syscalls, and is witnessed as active for each attested process's entire lifetime.

runner_executable_closure.dependency_rule: No repository-local helper outside the 17-member production closure may be imported or executed. P2 PASS writer, controller, production worker, reference worker and the non-PASS P2 capture routine are branches/functions in this one exact runner member and are audited under evaluator_dependency_contract.
runner_executable_closure.member_rule: For the sole member append uint64_be(path_ascii_byte_length), path_ascii, uint64_be(raw_file_byte_length), raw_file_bytes; raw bytes are not decoded or normalized.
runner_executable_closure.p2_capture_entry_point: main -> _capture_p2_gate_bundle; this routine only launches/captures the p2-verifier and writes CAPTURED_COMPLETE, never PASS
runner_executable_closure.reference_embedding_rule: The runner contains an exact byte literal equal to the Markdown TEMPORAC_P05M_REFERENCE_SOURCE_V1 block; candidate review extracts both, verifies byte equality and reference_source_sha256 before accepting the runner.

candidate_conformance_index.authoritative_when: A separate fresh candidate-review receipt binds exact canonical index bytes and accepts the complete production, runner, P2-verifier, runtime, attestation, command, dependency, origin-policy and snapshot closure. Candidate values may differ from all historical hashes.
candidate_conformance_index.candidate_dependency_edge_rule: edges use the same unique sorted [importer, imported] pairs as the audited DAG contract; module_origins has exactly the fixed 17 module_name/path pairs; package_initialization_order is exactly [pams,pams.temporac]
candidate_conformance_index.candidate_id_rule: candidate_id is 1 through 128 lowercase ASCII characters matching [a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]* and is assigned before fresh review
candidate_conformance_index.candidate_snapshot_rule: The member order is exactly the 17 production members followed by tests/temporac/test_p05m_fixture.py, using the stated candidate-snapshot prefix and path/raw-length member encoding. These same 18 records and root are the P2-verifier closure; no other repository byte is executable in P2 or K7.
candidate_conformance_index.command_template_hash_rule: Each command_templates role value obeys temporac.p05m-command-template.v1 and the same-role command_template_sha256s value hashes its complete canonical bytes plus one terminal LF.
candidate_conformance_index.embedded_hash_rule: Each embedded object is canonicalized independently with the amendment canonical-JSON rule; its adjacent sha256 field must equal those exact bytes.
candidate_conformance_index.member_object_rule: bytes is a nonnegative JSON integer equal to the following raw-file length; path is the exact ASCII member path at that array position; sha256 is 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters equal to the unchanged raw bytes.
candidate_conformance_index.no_self_hash: candidate_conformance_index_sha256 is absent and is computed only after canonical serialization
candidate_conformance_index.p2_verifier_closure_rule: p2_verifier_closure_members is byte-for-byte equal to candidate_snapshot_members and p2_verifier_closure_sha256 equals candidate_snapshot_sha256, both recomputed from the exact 18-member candidate-snapshot preimage. The final member implements the P2 capture and PASS-writer entry points. Any independent or merely syntactic 64-hex value is invalid.

candidate_review_receipt.reviewed_scope: complete candidate index including all 17 production members, exact runner/P2 capture/PASS-writer member, 18-member snapshot/P2 closure equality, runtime/dependency/command/sandbox/attestation contracts and both amendment output hashes

reviewer_witness_schema.identity_rule: amendment_author_identity_token, candidate_implementer_identity_token and reviewer_identity_token are three nonempty ASCII tokens and must be pairwise unequal; the reviewer assignment is issued by the independent review authority before review and binds reviewer, amendment and candidate index.
reviewer_witness_schema.reviewer_identity_rule: All identity tokens are opaque and assigned outside the candidate; they contain no account, host, credential or path secret. The reviewer process has read-only access to candidate bytes and cannot write candidate, runner, runtime, command or evidence inputs.

command_and_process_evidence.actual_command_rule: The only argv substitution is replacing the final literal <CHALLENGE_HEX_64> token by exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. The witness embeds actual_argv, and actual_argv_sha256 is the canonical JSON hash of that exact string array.
command_and_process_evidence.challenge_rule: The P2 capture root creates independent p2-verifier challenge/attestation nonce; p2-verifier creates independent controller values; controller creates independent production then reference values. All eight 32-byte values are generated by os.urandom, pairwise unequal, appear only as lowercase hex in the appropriate closed request/argv, and are bound by the child attestation and parent witness.
command_and_process_evidence.fresh_process_identity_preimage: ASCII temporac.p05m.process-identity.v2 plus NUL, uint64_be(pid), uint64_be(parent_pid), uint64_be(linux_start_time_ticks from /proc/self/stat field 22), raw32(role_challenge), raw32(actual_argv_sha256), raw32(executable_sha256), raw32(attestation_channel_id)

process_failure.attestation_failure_rule: On every failure before successful attestation commit, FD 3 is closed with zero bytes. If failure occurs after attestation commit or while writing stdout, the parent discards the attestation and all output and no process witness, gate evidence bundle or partial score is accepted.
process_failure.transport: stdout is empty; stderr is exactly the canonical error object plus one terminal LF; the attestation parent rejects any FD-3 bytes and no role observation, runner evidence, gate evidence or capture bundle exists

process_witness.attestation_source_rule: The parent must embed the exact canonical attestation object received through its retained pipe and derive all attestation/module/native/sandbox/output fields from those bytes. Copying an expected allowlist or accepting an attestation from stdout, stderr, a sibling FD or a file is forbidden.
process_witness.observed_pid_rule: The parent opens a pidfd immediately after spawn, compares pid/parent_pid/start-time with the OS handle and attestation, waits through that pidfd, and requires exit 0. All four pids and start-time identities are distinct; parent-child links are p2-capture-root->p2-verifier->controller->production then reference.
process_witness.output_binding_rule: output_object_sha256 must equal stdout_sha256 and the attestation value. primary_root_sha256 is the embedded observation root for production/reference and equals output_object_sha256 for controller/p2-verifier. The role-specific output schema must equal the command template.
process_witness.pidfd_exit_status_rule: pidfd_exit_status is the exact ASCII string CLD_EXITED:0 obtained from waitid(P_PIDFD) for the same retained pidfd; any signal, different status, PID reuse or non-pidfd wait is P05M_PROCESS_MISMATCH.
process_witness.work_mount_parent_rule: parent_final_work_mount_identity_sha256 must equal attestation.sandbox_witness.work_mount_identity_sha256 after the parent reopens the retained mount handle post-exit and independently recomputes the same identity and final empty-tree root.

sandbox_witness.work_mount_identity_preimage: ASCII temporac.p05m.work-mount-identity.v1 plus NUL, uint16_be(command_role length), command_role ASCII, raw32(role_challenge), raw32(mount_nonce), uint64_be(mount_id), uint64_be(st_dev), uint64_be(st_ino), raw32(initial_tree_sha256), raw32(final_tree_sha256)
sandbox_witness.witness_hash_rule: sandbox_witness_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete embedded canonical object plus one terminal LF. The in-process witness and parent's retained mount-handle final identity/root must agree exactly; all four role mount identities/nonces must be pairwise unequal.

observation_contract.attack_bytes_rule: attack_observed_sha256 hashes canonical temporac.count-metric-fixture-attack-expected.v1 bytes. Every one of the 17 scorer invocations must terminate with its exact error_code and GLOBAL_FAIL and must return no point, bootstrap, draw, row or partial payload.

observation_root.implementation_rule: production uses production_executable_closure_sha256; reference uses reference_source_sha256

role_observation.stdout_rule: The complete canonical role-observation bytes plus one LF are the child's entire stdout. Before stdout, the child hashes these exact bytes into its FD-3 attestation and closes that channel; the parent witness requires stdout_sha256=attestation.output_object_sha256 and the embedded root equality.

construction_order: validate the runner request, candidate index, fresh candidate review, mandatory inner summary, all embedded object hashes, amendment commitments, runtime lock, four command templates, P2 closure equality and immutable candidate snapshot
create distinct production challenge/attestation nonce and launch production through the exact FD-3 channel and read-only role mount; fully validate/close its process, pipe and mount
only then create distinct reference challenge/attestation nonce and repeat with a new pipe and distinct read-only role mount

for each child require attestation EOF before stdout, exit 0, empty stderr, exact stdout object, actual argv/environment/executable/pid/start-time/module/native/sandbox/work-mount state and all directional hash equalities
require one normal call and all 17 attacks in each implementation; require both normal bytes, attack bytes, 288-row root and raw-f64 draw hashes equal the frozen commitments
only then construct one canonical runner-execution-evidence object; controller next attests this exact output over its own FD 3 before writing stdout
runner_execution_evidence.no_pass_semantics: OBSERVED_COMPLETE is process evidence, not a P2 or gate PASS
runner_execution_evidence.stdout_rule: The controller's entire stdout is these canonical bytes plus one LF. Before stdout it writes a post-validation attestation binding this exact hash through FD 3; the p2-verifier derives the controller process witness only from that channel and stdout.

construction_order: the exact P2-verifier runner entry point validates fresh candidate review, recomputes all 18 candidate-snapshot/P2-closure member bytes and requires p2_verifier_closure_members==candidate_snapshot_members and p2_verifier_closure_sha256==candidate_snapshot_sha256
it creates fresh controller challenge/attestation nonce and launches exactly one controller from the exact reviewed command template, FD-3 channel and distinct read-only work mount

after controller exit it constructs its witness solely from the received attestation/stdout/pidfd/mount observations and revalidates both nested child observations/witnesses, exact counts, 288 rows, normal outputs, both 10000-draw raw roots and all 17 GLOBAL_FAIL attacks per implementation

it constructs the exact gate-evidence bytes with status PASS, snapshots its own post-verification module/native/sandbox state twice, writes an FD-3 attestation binding those gate bytes, closes FD 3, writes only those bytes to stdout and exits 0

the P2 capture root accepts no PASS yet; it must capture the verifier attestation/stdout/pidfd/mount state, construct the surrounding non-PASS gate-capture bundle and validate the entire chain before the P2 stage may transition
gate_evidence_receipt.hash_rule: gate_evidence_sha256 is computed from the complete canonical object plus one LF; the object contains no self hash and is inert unless embedded in a valid capture bundle
gate_evidence_receipt.pass_semantics: PASS is written only by the reviewed P2-verifier entry point in the exact 18-member closure after execution of controller, production, reference, normal scoring and all 17 attacks. A standalone gate-evidence PASS has zero P2/S0/G5a/K7 authority.

normal.estimate_rule: e=clamp(base_error_eighths[condition][arm][decimal_seed][component_index]+bias_eighths,0,8); estimate=count_gt-(count_gt*e//8); then exact stub override to zero

inner_hash_summary_receipt.mandatory_transport_rule: Exact canonical bytes and digest are mandatory at P2, embedded in gate evidence, committed by S0, revalidated at G5a and K7, and never accepted as a standalone gate input.
inner_hash_summary_receipt.mandatory_equality_rule: status is PASS; evaluator_code_sha256 equals the accepted candidate's complete production_executable_closure_sha256; fixture_input_sha256, expected_output_sha256 and attack_expected_global_fail_sha256 equal the amendment commitments. Any difference is STOP-METRIC.
inner_hash_summary_receipt.receipt_hash: SHA-256 over canonical JSON bytes including one terminal LF

status_semantics.GLOBAL_FAIL: An individual attack terminates the complete scorer atomically with its exact error code and returns no point, bootstrap, draw, row or partial payload.
status_semantics.PASS: The six hash fields are syntactically complete and mutually address frozen artifacts; no execution, review, P2, S0, G5a, K7, capability or launch conclusion follows.

reference_implementation.execution: The reference worker verifies the exact embedded LF-terminated ASCII source bytes, compiles with filename <temporac-p05m-reference-v1>, executes execute(fixture_input), and emits only the closed role observation.
forbidden: filesystem data access other than locked runtime/runner bytes
reference_implementation.independence: Production and reference run in distinct fresh processes with different role challenges. The production branch may not compile/import/call the reference; the reference branch may not import/call pams or SciPy.

runtime_contract.module_origin_rule: Every actual reference-process module origin is embedded in its witness and must resolve only to the exact runner, compiled reference source, locked CPython tree or locked NumPy 2.1.0 tree.
runtime_contract.runtime_lock_relation: Same exact runtime_lock object as the candidate, but the reference role forbids every pams and SciPy origin even though those trees are present for production.

reference_implementation.source_encoding: ASCII, LF line endings, exactly one terminal LF
reference_implementation.source_location: TEMPORAC_CONTRACT_AMENDMENT_003_P05M_FIXTURE.md block TEMPORAC_P05M_REFERENCE_SOURCE_V1 and exact embedded runner literal

P2: Treat historical_audit_basis only as provenance and use only a separately fresh-reviewed candidate index.
Require the mandatory six-key inner receipt as subordinate evidence; neither it nor temporac.p05m-gate-evidence.v2 can directly pass P2.

The reviewed 18-member P2 closure launches exactly one attested p2-verifier, which launches one attested controller; the controller sequentially launches one attested production and one attested reference child, each executing one normal score and all 17 attacks.

Require p2_verifier_closure_sha256=candidate_snapshot_sha256 from exact members, validate the verifier's FD-3/process/runtime/module/native/sandbox/work witness, then accept only one complete temporac.p05m-gate-capture-bundle.v1 as the P2 transition input.
S0: Accept only complete canonical temporac.p05m-gate-capture-bundle.v1 bytes and their external digest as the P05M gate input.

Before commit, recursively validate the nested PASS, mandatory inner receipt, candidate/review, exact 18-member P2 closure equality, runner evidence, all four process witnesses/attestations, both observations, runtime/module/native/sandbox/work state and every root.
Commit the exact bundle bytes/digest plus the immutable content-addressed candidate snapshot; no P05M artifact is optional and no inner object is accepted separately.
G5a: Load only the S0-bound gate-capture bundle and immutable candidate snapshot; reject standalone gate evidence or inner receipt.

Recompute all 17 production raw members/closure and all 18 P2 verifier members/closure; require production closure equality across candidate/S0/G5a and P2 closure equality with candidate_snapshot_sha256.
Write only the exact 17-member production closure digest into the existing closed evaluator_code_sha256 field; add no P05M key and compute no human statistic.
K7_prestart: Before evaluator construction, process start or any capability-consumed transition, validate the exact S0-bound gate-capture bundle recursively, including fresh review and the p2-verifier attestation/process witness.

Recompute runner raw bytes, all 17 production members, exact 18-member candidate/P2 closure, dependency DAG, runtime trees, module/native policies, all four command templates, attestation transport, work-mount identities and every observation/process/root equality from the immutable snapshot that will be launched.

Require the bundle/S0/G5a/capability grant to agree on the 17-member production closure and require the bundle/candidate review/S0 to agree on the 18-member P2 closure=candidate snapshot; missing/mismatch yields STOP-METRIC and consumes nothing.

Only after all byte checks succeed may K7 atomically start the sole non-resumable evaluator from that verified snapshot; successful OS process creation is the only capability-consumption point. Preserve the existing G5b to K7 order.

mismatches: metrics.py derives component order by bytewise token sort and paired_component_bootstrap accepts no explicit frozen component_order; the fixture order is intentionally nonlexical.

count_metric_fixture_receipt hashes caller-provided bytes and emits PASS without executing production, reference or any attack.

current_production_conformance.rule: All current source/test hashes and the historical 17-member root are provenance only. No authoritative 18-member candidate/P2 closure can exist until implementation is frozen and separately freshly reviewed.

self_binding_policy.amendment: Neither amendment output contains its own digest. The later candidate-review receipt binds externally computed MD and JSON hashes.
self_binding_policy.candidate_index: Contains no candidate_conformance_index_sha256; review, runner request, runner evidence and gate evidence bind its external canonical digest.
self_binding_policy.evidence: Role observations do not contain stdout hashes; their parent FD-3 attestations prehash stdout and parent witnesses bind the exact pipe bytes, stdout and roots. Runner evidence does not contain its own digest; the controller attestation and P2 witness bind it. Gate evidence cannot contain its later process witness and is therefore inert alone; the non-PASS capture bundle directionally binds gate stdout to the P2-verifier witness and is the sole stage input.
self_binding_policy.historical_separation: Rejected fixed pairs are bound only through immutable 20260816_145644 and 20260816_162320 archive members; current output paths are not members of their own historical basis.
self_binding_policy.rule: No PASS-bearing object establishes authority by checking only self-generated hashes. The PASS writer is inside the exact reviewed 18-member closure, its output is precommitted on the dedicated parent-observed pipe, and P2 transitions only after the surrounding process witness/bundle is complete.

review.required_next_action: fresh independent review of both Round-4 amendment mirrors and, later, the complete candidate production/runner/P2-verifier/runtime/attestation closure before any implementation or gate claim

p2_verifier_executable_closure.authoritative_root_rule: The authoritative p2_verifier_closure_sha256 exists only in a separately fresh-reviewed candidate index. It must equal candidate_snapshot_sha256 and cannot be supplied as an independent hexadecimal string.
p2_verifier_executable_closure.member_rule: Start with the exact candidate-snapshot prefix, then for each member append uint64_be(path_ascii_byte_length), path_ascii, uint64_be(raw_file_byte_length), raw_file_bytes. Lengths are unsigned 64-bit big-endian; bytes are unchanged and unnormalized.
p2_verifier_executable_closure.root_equality_rule: candidate.p2_verifier_closure_members must be element-for-element equal to candidate.candidate_snapshot_members; candidate.p2_verifier_closure_sha256 must equal candidate.candidate_snapshot_sha256 and both must equal SHA-256 of this exact 18-member preimage. Candidate review, P2 capture, S0 and K7 recompute all three equalities; arbitrary 64-hex values are rejected.
p2_verifier_executable_closure.runtime_binding_rule: The PASS entry point executes only from the exact runner member under the candidate runtime lock and p2-verifier command template. The non-PASS capture/launcher routine is also in that reviewed runner member, is invoked by the existing P2 stage observation trust root under the same runtime lock, and can emit only CAPTURED_COMPLETE. The PASS writer's actual module/native/sandbox state and stdout are bound by FD-3 attestation and its parent process witness before the surrounding bundle can become the sole gate input.

attestation_object.canonical_bytes_rule: Canonical JSON uses the amendment rule and exactly one terminal LF. attestation_sha256 is SHA-256 of all of those received bytes; the object contains no self hash.

channel.channel_id_preimage: ASCII temporac.p05m.attestation-channel.v1 plus NUL, uint16_be(command_role ASCII length), command_role ASCII, raw32(candidate_conformance_index_sha256), raw32(role_challenge), raw32(attestation_nonce), raw32(kernel_pipe_token_sha256), uint64_be(parent_pid), uint64_be(pid), uint64_be(linux_start_time_ticks), uint32_be(child_write_fd), uint32_be(parent_read_fd)
close_and_output_order: finish the one normal plus 17 attacks, or for p2-verifier finish all validation and construct the exact output object bytes
take two byte-identical complete module/native/sandbox snapshots and construct the canonical attestation bytes
write all attestation bytes plus its sole LF to FD 3 using an os.write retry loop; no other writer exists
do not call fsync; close FD 3 exactly once, making parent EOF the attestation commit boundary
only after close succeeds write the prehashed output object plus one LF to stdout and flush; successful stderr remains empty
exit 0 without importing another module, opening another FD or changing the work mount
channel.creation_rule: The immediate parent calls os.pipe2(O_CLOEXEC) before spawn, retains the read end, maps only the write end to child FD 3 with POSIX_SPAWN_DUP2, closes the original child write descriptor, and never passes any sibling read/write end. All other nonstandard child FDs are closed. The parent records the exact kernel pipe token from both /proc links and requires equality before accepting bytes.
channel.descriptor_allocation_rule: Immediately before pipe2, the P2 stage capture root has exactly FDs [0,1,2], so Linux returns read FD 3/write FD 4. An attested parent launching its sole next child has exactly [0,1,2,3], so Linux returns read FD 4/write FD 5. POSIX_SPAWN_DUP2 maps only the write end to child FD 3 and closes the original end; production is fully closed before reference reuses parent read FD 4. Any different prelaunch FD set, allocation or inherited descriptor is P05M_ATTESTATION_MISMATCH.
channel.fsync_rule: FD 3 is an anonymous pipe, so fsync is inapplicable and forbidden; any fsync attempt or non-EINVAL-dependent fallback is P05M_ATTESTATION_MISMATCH. Completion is exact writer close plus parent-observed EOF.
channel.kernel_pipe_token_rule: kernel_pipe_token_sha256 is SHA-256 of the exact ASCII pipe:[decimal-inode] token observed independently at the parent's retained read FD and child's FD 3. The raw inode token is not emitted.
channel.nonce_rule: The immediate parent generates one fresh 32-byte os.urandom attestation nonce per launch, transmits its 64 lowercase hex form only in that child's closed stdin request, and rejects reuse across all four roles. The nonce differs from every role challenge.
channel.read_rule: The parent drains only its retained read FD through EOF before reading successful stdout, rejects zero bytes, more than max_bytes, invalid UTF-8, BOM, CR, missing/additional LF, duplicate keys, noncanonical bytes, wrong schema/role/challenge/nonce/channel/output hash or any trailing byte, closes the read FD, then reads stdout/stderr and waits through the spawn pidfd.
channel.role_sequencing_rule: The p2-verifier launches controller; controller launches production then fully validates/closes its channel and mount before launching reference. Thus each parent child-channel uses its exact fixed read FD and a distinct kernel pipe, nonce, challenge and channel ID.
channel.sidecar_rule: O_EXCL files, writable directories, shared memory, inherited anonymous FDs other than child FD 3, sockets, stderr and stdout are forbidden as attestation transports.

completeness.module_rule: The attestation embeds the complete actual two-snapshot sys.modules origin array required by runtime_lock_contract, not an expected allowlist copy. Its hash is recomputed from received bytes.
completeness.native_rule: The attestation embeds the complete actual two-snapshot executable-map plus recursive ELF closure array, not only a digest. Its hash and equality/subset relation to the locked runtime manifest are recomputed.
completeness.sandbox_rule: The attestation embeds the actual role sandbox witness including FD table [0,1,2,3], role-specific work mount identity, initial/final empty roots, proc-source hashes, network/GPU/policy state and total spawned-child count.
completeness.timing_rule: All three complete observations are taken after scoring/output construction and before attestation serialization. Two consecutive snapshots must be byte-identical; any late import, mapping, FD or mount change is GLOBAL_FAIL.

gate_capture_bundle_contract.capture_root_closure_rule: The monitor/launcher is not an unspecified helper: its exact _capture_p2_gate_bundle implementation is in the sole runner member and therefore in the freshly reviewed 18-member P2 closure. It runs under the same runtime lock as the P2 verifier. The existing P2 stage observation root supplies the initial challenge/pipe/mount handles, cannot write PASS, and accepts no transition until it independently revalidates the resulting closed bundle.
construction_order: the P2 capture root creates the verifier challenge, attestation nonce, distinct read-only work mount, exact stdin bytes and anonymous attestation pipe, then launches the reviewed p2-verifier command

it drains the exact retained pipe through EOF before reading stdout, requires exact canonical attestation and gate-evidence bytes, empty stderr, pidfd exit 0 and final empty mount, and constructs the verifier process witness solely from those observations

it recursively validates the candidate/review, 18-member P2 closure equality, controller and both child witnesses, all attestation channel IDs/nonces/challenges/pipe tokens, output hashes, module/native/sandbox/work roots and frozen scientific commitments

only then it writes one canonical CAPTURED_COMPLETE bundle; the bundle carries no PASS token of its own and merely transports the reviewed verifier's nested PASS with nonreplaceable execution evidence
gate_capture_bundle_contract.hash_rule: gate_capture_bundle_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete canonical bundle plus one LF; the object contains no self hash
gate_capture_bundle_contract.p2_acceptance_rule: This complete bundle, never the inner six-key receipt and never gate evidence alone, is the sole P05M input to the P2 transition and every downstream S0/G5a/K7 verification. Missing verifier attestation/process witness, arbitrary closure hex, any transport substitution or any extra/missing key is STOP-METRIC.
